subject: Catalog dynamic hubs: second half of the 2026-07-29 'Option A approved' mechanism (unified-hub-registry.md ~:304) is UNBUILT -- catalog.html has zero Firestore wiring, so admin-created hubs (cloud-master) do not appear in /catalog.html. Not a regression (never existed) but the ruling says 'Catalog gains dynamic hubs too, since a distribution hub invisible to catalog browsers defeats its purpose.' Natural pairing: fold into the #232 catalog pass (container flat-render). Caught by Chris blocking the dynamic-hub ship 2026-07-29.
